title: Prefabricated vacation homes and saunas from Finland
summary: CBP classified small complete wooden sauna buildings with prefabricated buildings of wood; appliances, if included, were to be classified separately.

title: Classification of a non-freestanding DIY cedar sauna kit
summary: CBP Headquarters classified the electric sauna heater as other electric space-heating apparatus while treating the other kit components separately.

title: The tariff classification of sauna kits from Canada
summary: CBP rejected heading 9406 for a non-freestanding sauna kit that depended on an existing building for framing, walls, roof and other structural elements.

title: The tariff classification of a prefabricated sauna
summary: CBP determined that a freestanding, weather-resistant cross-laminated-timber sauna met the definition of a prefabricated building of wood.

title: The tariff classification of a portable infrared sauna from China
summary: CBP classified a portable covered sauna with infrared panels and accessories as an other domestic electrothermic appliance.

title: Outdoor barrel saunas; USMCA; Section 301 trade remedies
summary: CBP analyzed outdoor barrel saunas manufactured through operations in Canada, China and Mexico, addressing classification, country of origin, USMCA and Section 301 consequences.

title: The tariff classification of a wool sauna hat from Russia
summary: CBP classified a merino wool felt sauna hat as wool headgear, illustrating the broader range of sauna-related articles outside the core cabin and heater categories.
